page.overview:
Who is Jarna Malari?

Jarna Malari (pronounced: JAHR-nah MAL-ah-ree) was an Aes Sedai and Sitter for the Gray Ajah and secretly head of the Black Ajah.

She had liquid brown eyes and long black hair which was going white at the temples., Jarna Malari|Jarna Malari}} She was 5'6" or 168 cm in height.

She was well-loved and respected by many Aes Sedai, seen as a model of virtue with a saintly reputation.

Sometime prior to the Aiel War, she was made a Sitter for the Gray Ajah. She was also appointed head of the Supreme Council of the Black Ajah at an unknown point.
